en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard image showing the entrance to a mountain hotel. A wooden archway with the word "HÔTEL" stands over a path lined with tall cedar trees. People are visible near deck chairs on the left and with horses on the right, suggesting an alpine or hill resort. Snow patches are visible on the ground. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the entrance of Hôtel des Cèdres at Col de Chréa near Blida.
